title: Remote compromise of a Rockwell 1756-EN2T through a crafted CIP request

attacker_profile.description: An attacker controlling an engineering workstation with network reachability to the Logix module.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker gains control of an engineering workstation.

attack_path.name: Access to Cell/Area Network
attack_path.description: The attacker reaches the EtherNet/IP network.

attack_path.name: Reach Communication Module
attack_path.description: The attacker reaches the 1756-EN2T over the industrial network.

attack_path.name: Malicious CIP Request
attack_path.description: The attacker sends a maliciously crafted CIP request to the module.
required_conditions: CIP messages can reach the module.

attack_path.name: Compromise Communication Module
attack_path.description: Successful exploitation may allow attacker-controlled code execution.
required_conditions: The crafted request triggers an applicable vulnerability.

attack_path.name: Impact
attack_path.description: Compromise may impair confidentiality, integrity, or availability of industrial communications.
required_conditions: The module is used for active controller communications.

global_preconditions: The module is reachable using CIP/EtherNet/IP.
assumptions: Product, version, and prerequisite checks must all match.
